_description: SLH-DSA-SHA2-192f (FIPS 205) known-answer tests for the external, pure (non-pre-hash) interface, the one DCP uses. Signing is randomized, so these are signature-verification cases: the valid one only verifies if the 0x00 || len(ctx) || ctx prefix of FIPS 205 is applied, which pre-standard SPHINCS+ omits. DCP signs with an empty context; these NIST cases carry one, so the test passes it explicitly. Values are copied verbatim from NIST ACVP; never edit them to match an SDK.
